visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a black tank top, sits in a studio holding a smartphone. He looks focused as he scrolls through the screen. Behind him, two vertical monitors display high-definition crackling fireplace animations, creating a warm, cozy background. (2) The camera pans across a cluttered professional desk featuring a large condenser microphone on a boom arm, a mirror, and several camera setups. The walls are covered in dark grey acoustic foam panels. (3) A screen capture of the ZecZec crowdfunding platform is shown, highlighting a product titled 'qbarmour 立方盾'. The page displays a funding progress of 688% and images of a screen protector. (4) Hands carefully open a white product box, revealing a translucent screen protector secured with orange protective film. The setting is a wooden desk with miscellaneous cards nearby. (5) The man holds the 'qbarmour' box toward the camera with a slight smile, then holds his own phone horizontally, demonstrating how the screen protector looks installed. (6) A comedic jump cut shows the man in a brightly lit bedroom, wearing a flesh-colored muscle suit that mimics a highly toned physique. He strikes a dramatic pose while holding a small camera. (7) Close-up shots alternate between the man's eye and the phone screen, which displays a 3D video of a Corgi dog. The depth on the screen appears to pop out significantly. (8) The smartphone screen displays an app interface with options to toggle between 2D and 3D playback for YouTube content. (9) A sequence of clips shows the phone being used outdoors on a grassy lawn, displaying a 3D dog playing with a ball, and indoors showing a child. (10) A horizontal demonstration shows a CGI dinosaur lunging toward the viewer on the phone screen, emphasizing the 3D effect. (11) Back in the studio, the man shows the phone's lock screen and then cuts back to another comedic pose in the muscle suit, flexing his arms. (12) The man makes a finger heart and winks at the camera as the video concludes with a promotional slogan overlay.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged Asian man with messy brown hair, wearing black glasses and a black sleeveless tank top in the studio, and a tan muscle suit in comedic segments.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dark-toned professional studio with soundproofing, monitors, and recording equipment; a bright modern bedroom with a bed and white curtains.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a male narrator speaking energetically in a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone, accompanied by a fast-paced electronic pop background track. A sharp 'whoosh' transition effect occurs almost immediately. (2) As the scene shifts to the desk, a digital UI 'blip' is heard, followed by a rhythmic pop beat (approx. 128 BPM) that maintains high momentum. (3) The narrator's speech rate increases while explaining the crowdfunding page, punctuated by a 'ping' sound effect when highlighting text. (4) Faint rustling of plastic and cardboard is audible during the unboxing segment, but the BGM and vocal track remain dominant. (5) A cartoonish 'boing' sound effect marks the transition to the comedic muscle suit segment, where the speaker's tone becomes playfully exaggerated. (6) Precise digital UI clicks and 'sparkle' SFX accompany the eye-tracking demonstration, suggesting high-tech functionality. (7) An 'impact' hit SFX sounds during the dinosaur clip, adding weight to the visual depth demo. (8) The phase ends with a friendly, closing vocal flourish followed by a 'chu' (kiss) sound effect and a cheerful brand jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Feature Presentation -> Personal Demonstration -> Comedic Engagement -> Final Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'qbarmour 立方盾' 3D screen protector by demonstrating its unique glasses-free 3D capabilities and eye-tracking features using high-energy humor and technical demonstrations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product name, packaging, crowdfunding page, and call-to-action to buy.
